plan.title: Invalid URL Attachment on Saved Draft

steps.note: Create the eRFX draft required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory draft title so the saved draft can be found again.
Configure the draft with a template before adding line items.
Add the minimum line item needed for a valid eRFX draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Save the eRFX as a draft for the attachment scenario.
Return to the events list to follow the specified Drafts navigation.
Open the Drafts tab where the saved eRFX should appear.
Assert that the saved draft is present in the Drafts list.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Open the Upload Attachments window on the saved draft.
Assert that the attachment window opened.
Choose the Add URL attachment path.
Enter the invalid text specified by the test case; the field label is not confirmed in the catalog.
Attempt to save the invalid URL attachment.
Assert that no application error was shown after saving, recording the observable outcome available to the catalog.
